summary: CytoSorbents filed an 8-K disclosing Nasdaq listing-compliance developments. On September 22, 2026, Nasdaq Staff confirmed the company regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule and closed that matter, originally flagged October 2, 2025. Separately, a June 29, 2026 notice stated listed-securities market value fell below the $35 million MVLS threshold under Rule 5550(b)(2); Nasdaq granted until December 28, 2026 to regain compliance via ten consecutive business days at or above $35 million, or alternatively $2.5 million stockholders' equity. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation were disclosed. Watch for reverse-split, equity-raise, or delisting-appeal announcements before the December deadline.
